comments.body: This trade good is very good for Taiwan nanban purpose, although the amount of quantity for getting them is not high (99~104 at R20 perfume in Pisa).

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Thank you for the information. Additionally, it seems this trade good can be acquired through:

Collection skill R11 or higher at Hisarlik Hill
Plants Habitat Map treasure map acquired from from London and Calicut Archives (quantity yielded per map unknown at this time)

I look forward to trying this for my next Nanban trip to Taiwan.
